data.本站追蹤哪些帳號？: Which accounts does this site track?
data.目前追蹤 201 個帳號，其中 200 個在 X、1 個在 Truth Soci: It currently tracks 201 accounts: 200 on X and 1 on Truth Social, in 6 categories: major figures and entrepreneurs, macro, equity opinions, fundamentals and themes, semiconductors and AI, and traders. A post is kept only when the post or the post it quotes has a ticker, a company name or ticker from the price data, or a macro term such as the Fed, inflation, jobs, interest rates, or Treasury yields. Chat with none of that is not summarised and is not shown.
data.看好和看淡是怎樣判斷的？: How are bullish and bearish decided?
data.分析師為每則貼文的每隻股票標示四種立場之一：睇好、睇淡、中性、未表態，頁面上顯示: The analyst labels each ticker in a post as one of four stances: bullish, bearish, neutral or no stance. The page reads that per-ticker stance and does not use one stance for the whole post. Only when a post has no per-ticker stance, and the whole post is bullish, bearish or neutral, is that whole-post stance applied to each ticker in the post and marked with a star. Joint bullish means that, inside the day's data window, at least 2 accounts' latest stance on that confirmed US stock is bullish and no account is bearish. Joint bearish is the reverse. If some accounts are bullish and some are bearish, the ticker is a split and is not a joint call. A category marked as excluded from consensus does not take part; all 6 categories currently take part. Neutral and no-stance do not by themselves make a joint call.
